title: Noise: coffee, planning and jokes

subject: Friday chat

messages.text: Who is bringing the cinnamon buns on Friday? 🥐
Not me, I did the last two times. Jaakko?
I can do it! Do we want the cardamom ones too?
Cardamom or I'm not coming. Also the weekly planning is moved to 13:00, the room is booked.
13:00 works. Did anyone see the football last night?
Don't remind me. My team lost again.
Joke of the day: why did the engineer cross the road? To patch the other side. 😄
